SpamRule
  Defines a spam filter rule for message classification.

  Variants:
    Any: Any
      Fields:
        condition    object<Expression>  mutable
            Expression that returns the tag to assign to the message.
        description  string<string>?  mutable
            Description for the rule
        enable       boolean  mutable
            Whether to enable this rule
        name         string<string>  immutable
            Short name for the rule
        priority     number<integer>  mutable
            The priority of the rule
    Url: URL
      Fields:
